title: docs: Deprecate format-internal fields on Cipher
body:
## 🎟️ Tracking

No ticket. Related epic: https://bitwarden.atlassian.net/browse/PM-21771. TS counterpart of bitwarden/sdk-internal#1535.

## 📔 Objective

Mark the encryption-format internal fields of the encrypted `Cipher` domain model as `@deprecated` (not public API): `name`, `notes`, `login`, `identity`, `card`, `secureNote`, `sshKey`, `bankAccount`, `driversLicense`, `passport`, `fields`, `passwordHistory`, and the opaque `data` blob. A class-level doc lists the stable metadata fields and points callers to `CipherView` / `CipherListView`.

With v2 (blob) encryption these fields are `undefined` and all sensitive data is sealed in `data`. This caused multiple bugs already. Code outside the encryption layer that reads them silently drops or empties v2 items, e.g. encrypted JSON export (#23546), clone passkey warning (#23547), Item Send serialization (#23548).

comments.body:
## 🤖 Bitwarden Claude Code Review

**Overall Assessment:** APPROVE

This PR adds documentation only: a class-level doc block on `Cipher` plus 14 `@deprecated` JSDoc tags on the encryption-format-dependent fields in `libs/common/src/vault/models/domain/cipher.ts`. No runtime behavior, types, or signatures change, and the stable/deprecated split described in the doc matches how the class actually populates those fields in the constructor, `fromJSON`, `toCipherData`, `toSdkCipher`, and `fromSdkCipher`. Lint and the client test suites are green on the PR, and no dependency manifests or Claude configuration files are touched.
